mapper.select: SELECT cl.comment_id FROM comment_like cl INNER JOIN comment c ON cl.comment_id = c.id WHERE cl.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY cl.created_at DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO comment_like (user_id, comment_id) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.commentId})
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM comment_like WHERE (user_id, comment_id) IN
(#{item.userId}, #{item.commentId})
